decisive_items: symptoms usually occurred 6-20 hours after alcohol ingestion
response.rationale: R4 is the champion because it has strong support from the patient's long history of alcohol overconsumption and symptoms worsening after alcohol ingestion, which suggests alcoholic cardiomyopathy. R1 is the runner-up because it has some support from the ECG finding of high-degree atrioventricular block, but it is not as strong as R4's support.

rejected.why: lack of significant coronary stenosis makes obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy less likely
lack of significant coronary stenosis makes variant angina less likely
limited support from short bursts of ventricular tachycardia
